summary: compat-xpack fix round: all 16 review findings handled. Fixed with regression tests: SAMPLE before LIMIT, multi-value comparison warnings, point z values, union-type RENAME/binary, union unit test (all done by the previous session and re-verified against ES 9.5.5), COUNT_DISTINCT now ES's HLL++, ENRICH geo_match with real INTERSECTS, -0.0 grouping, WKT conversion warnings and edge cases, terms_enum paging, async id validation, SHOW FUNCTIONS LIKE, transform percentiles, a fuller profile emulation, lazy OrdCache, and SQL on fields without doc values. One part of the SQL finding is not a defect: ES also prints HISTOGRAM values as doubles in a long column. Probes against ES found two more bugs, also fixed: INLINE STATS with multi-valued keys, and `-0.0 == 0.0` being false. ES and OpenSearch YAML: 0 regressions.
public_api: Unchanged: search_es::xpack::{dispatch, implemented, Runtime}, xpack::esql::exec::execute, xpack::esql::CAPABILITIES. Changed or new in xpack::esql: spatial::{Check {None, Geo, Cartesian}, Check::of(DataType), parse_checked(&str, Check) -> Result<Geometry, String>, convert_checked(&str, DataType) -> Result<String, String> (Err is the Java exception text of the warning)}; spatial::parse/convert keep their Option signatures but now follow ES's WellKnownBinary.fromWKT grammar (EMPTY POINT/CIRCLE/BBOX fail, NaN/Infinity accepted, trailing input ignored); spatial::st_coordinate now returns Result<Option<f64>, String>. value::Acc::for_spec(name, arg_ty, extra), Acc::Distinct{hll, ty}, value::ordered(a, b) -> Option<Ordering> (IEEE order for doubles); value::eq uses Java's == for doubles. profile::Shape::of(&Query), and profile::build(cluster, start_ms, nanos, unmapped, &Shape, &Stats, &Table) takes a new &Shape argument. exec::refs is pub(crate). ES|QL and SQL async ids now come from async_results::async_id (AsyncExecutionId format) and go through async_results::check_id.
done: COUNT_DISTINCT (esql/value.rs): ES HllStates HyperLogLog++ via search_aggs::metrics::cardinality::Hll, precision_from_threshold(default 3000 or the second argument). Hashes: mix64 for longs, ints, dates and booleans; mix64(doubleToLongBits) for doubles; mix64(murmur3 h1) for keyword, text, version (encoded) and ip (16 bytes). ES|QL mixes the murmur hash a second time, unlike the cardinality agg. Equal to ES on 6/6 probes (20k values); unit test count_distinct_is_elasticsearchs_hll. Memory is now fixed-size, with no String allocated per row.

-0.0 (esql/exec.rs, functions.rs, value.rs): group keys, hash_key, same_key and VALUES use the double bits, so -0.0 and 0.0 are separate groups. Dedup inside one multi-value (STATS BY keys, expand_keys, MV_DEDUPE) uses Java's ==, as MultivalueDedupe does. Comparisons use IEEE semantics (-0.0 == 0.0 is true, NaN is unordered). Probe 17/17.
INLINE STATS with a multi-valued key now joins every group the key falls in, and each aggregate becomes a multi-value, as ES does. It used to return null. Probe 3/3.

Spatial (esql/spatial.rs): new Reader implementing ES's StreamTokenizer and WellKnownBinary.fromWKT grammar, with its exact error texts (expected word/number/EMPTY or (, coordinate dimensions do not match, Z/M check, Unknown geometry type, Empty POINT/CIRCLE/ENVELOPE cannot be represented in WKB, max x/y cannot be less than min, invalid longitude/latitude). Java parseDouble handles hex floats, Infinity and d/f suffixes; '#' starts a comment; a non-word token is consumed after the type. TO_GEO*/TO_CARTESIAN* warn once per failed value. ST_X/ST_Y on cartesian points warn 'invalid value Infinity; must be between ...' when the float is not finite. EMPTY parts print inside MULTI* geometries. Probe 74/74 including warning headers; unit test wkt_errors_match_elasticsearch; fixture esql_wkt.json.

ENRICH geo_match (xpack/enrich.rs): replaced bbox-corner matching with a planar INTERSECTS over points, lines and polygons with holes (containment, crossings, boundaries, envelopes crossing the dateline, circles as 64-gons), used by both ingest and ES|QL. [lon, lat] arrays in enrich docs count as one point. ES|QL ENRICH checks the match column's type ('Unsupported type [keyword] for enrich matching field [s]; only [geo_point, geo_shape] allowed for type [geo_match]', and the non-geo list for match/range). Probe 18/18; unit test geo_shape_inputs_intersect; fixture esql_enrich_geo.json.

terms_enum (xpack/terms_enum.rs): keyword, version and flattened subfields read each segment's term dictionary (search_codec TermsReader::range); ip reads its sorted-set doc-values dictionary. Each segment seeks past search_after and to the prefix byte range, takes at most size matches, and the results merge in byte order. Version prefixes match the decoded text. boolean fields and flattened roots return [] as ES 9.5.5 does. constant_keyword and wildcard keep the aggregation path. Probe 23/23 (1500 keyword and 12000 version terms); fixture terms_enum_paging.json; unit test matching_rules.

Async ids: GET/DELETE/stop on /_query/async/{id} and GET/status/DELETE on /_sql/async/... run async_results::check_id ('invalid id: [abc]' caused by e_o_f_exception). ES|QL and SQL async ids are now generated by async_id (AsyncExecutionId format); the first YAML run caught the old random ids failing validation.

SQL (xpack/sql.rs): SHOW FUNCTIONS LIKE uses a real SQL LIKE (sql_like: % and _, everything else literal). GROUP BY, aggregates (except COUNT(field)) and ORDER BY on fields without doc values return ES's error by running the same agg or sort through the core search API (check_doc_values). HISTOGRAM double values in a long column match ES, so that part of the finding is not a defect. Fixture sql_review.json, which also covers the async id errors; unit test show_functions_like_is_sql_like.

Transform (xpack/transform.rs): percentiles keys follow OutputFieldNameConverter.fromDouble (50, 99_5), in ascending order, with NaN written as null. Deduced mappings add name:{object} plus name.leaf:double for percentiles, stats, extended_stats and boxplot, so dest indices map p.50 as double. Numbers written to integral targets drop their fraction (max over long is written as 99). stats count is written as a double. extended_stats std_deviation_bounds uses ES's 8-bucket hash order. Fixture transform_objects.json; unit tests in transform tests.

ES|QL profile (esql/profile.rs, mod.rs): profile::Shape from the parsed query. The data driver adds HashAggregationOperator/AggregationOperator in INITIAL mode; the final driver adds the FINAL aggregation, ProjectOperator and LimitOperator[limit = remaining/limit] in ES's order; maxPageSize is 262144 / estimated row size; plans is a non-empty list of data, node_reduce and final with plan/logical_plan trees.

Columnar OrdCache (esql/columnar.rs): the per-segment table is allocated only after 64 direct decodes, so LIMIT 1 and the top-n second pass no longer zero a 64k-entry table per column per segment. Unit test ord_cache_is_built_only_for_repeated_reads.
ES|QL warnings recorded before a failure, such as the implicit 'No limit defined', are now sent with the error response, as ES does.

Re-verified the previous session's fixes against ES 9.5.5 (SAMPLE|LIMIT, multi-value warnings for ==/>/LIKE/IN/WHERE, LENGTH header, TO_LONG per-value warnings, RENAME of a union, binary+keyword): 8/8 equal. The only difference was the missing limit warning on error responses, now fixed.
docs/search/compatibility.md x-pack bullet: HLL++, block-hash -0.0 semantics, the WKT reader, INTERSECTS geo_match, profile operators, terms_enum dictionaries.
remaining: The search-es lib unit tests don't compile in the shared tree because of other lanes' in-progress test code (opensearch/ism.rs patterns_overlap, ingest/processors.rs geo grid tests, search/runtime_query.rs private matches). In a copy with those tests stripped: 434 passed, 2 failed, both document::fast in the perf lane. Re-run cargo test -p search-es --lib once they compile.

Transform: dest mapping key order for colliding hash buckets differs from ES when several object aggs are present (ES's insertion order across aggregations is unclear); range agg output keys (ES '*-1', roll '*-1.0') and their mappings; _meta key order in the dest index mapping.

ES|QL profile is still emulated: operator descriptions don't include ES's evaluator, encoder or blockHash details; plan text is a command tree without attribute ids; maxPageSize uses 50 bytes for loaded fields missing from the output columns (SUM(n) gives 4854 where ES gives 21845).
ip terms_enum: an unparseable search_after returns [] where ES reports a shard failure (UnknownHostException); ip prefixes match the address text rather than ES's buildIpPrefixAutomaton.
MV_DEDUPE of a constant ROW [0.0, -0.0] keeps both values on ES (folding path) but one on roll (block path, == dedupe).
Remaining platinum ES|QL failures and unclaimed families listed in build-compat-xpack-r3.json (FORK, TS/aggregate_metric_double, dense_vector, ST_* relations and aggregations, EXPLAIN).
tests: YAML on the final tree: ES 9.5.5 3905 tests, 3809 passed, 1 failed (free:search.vectors/210_knn_search_profile, not in the baseline), 95 skipped, 0 regressions. OpenSearch 3.9.0 1506 tests, 1455 passed, 0 failed, 51 skipped, 0 regressions. Integration tests (cargo test -p search-es --test '*'): all green, including xpack_fixtures (1097 steps; new fixtures esql_review, esql_enrich_geo, esql_wkt, terms_enum_paging, sql_review, transform_objects). Lib unit tests, run in a copy because the shared tree's lib tests don't compile: xpack 141 passed / 0 failed; the whole lib 434 passed / 2 failed (document::fast, perf lane). Clippy -p search-es --all-targets --no-deps (in that copy): no findings in xpack/, query/geo.rs or document/values.rs; other lanes' files still have some. Differential probes against ES 9.5.5: COUNT_DISTINCT 6/6, -0.0 17/17, INLINE STATS 3/3, WKT 74/74 including warnings, ENRICH 18/18, terms_enum 23/23, SQL and async 13/13 apart from node ids, previous-session findings 8/8.
notes_for_others: compat-os: in opensearch/ism.rs the tests call patterns_overlap, which no longer exists, so every search-es lib unit test fails to compile in the shared tree.

perf/compat-es: ingest/processors.rs tests (tile.children/hash.children are now Result) and search/runtime_query.rs tests (private matches) don't compile. document::fast tests everything_else_takes_the_general_path and geonames_documents_take_the_fast_path fail.

compat-es: query::geo::Geometry is now also built by xpack::esql::spatial::parse_checked with ES's WKB-path rules. Empty points never come out of it, and NaN or Infinity coordinates can appear in cartesian shapes.

durability: ES|QL and SQL async result ids are now AsyncExecutionId-format (async_results::async_id), like async search and EQL. Results stored under the old random ids won't validate, but they expire with keep_alive.

Probe harness: /tmp/compat-xpack-probe (probe.py, warn.py compares warning headers, sqlp.py, tofixture.py, suites.sh; case files in fix/). Private ES container roll-es-compat-xpack and search-dev are stopped. Running log: ~/.cache/roll-search/reports/live/compat-xpack.progress.md.
